question_paraphrase: After a common description of investment in data centers for AI and other applications, choose whether benefits or costs outweigh the other; separately choose the issue that matters most right now from a supplied list.
caveats: Data-center attitude is not a measured share voting on data centers. | Current-issue choices added housing and the SAVE Act and removed the deficit in July; no clean trend from April Iran 24% to July 10%. The question asks current importance, not whether the issue determines the respondent's vote. | Party subgroups have larger uncertainty; no inferred individual cross-party coalition behavior. | AI bad-for-society July level equals April rather than showing a monotonic increase.
